audit.name: Union Eyes CUPE National capability-truth audit
audit.state: commit plus pre-existing dirty working tree; audit adds only reports/audits/cupe-national-*

scenarios.question: Can CUPE model National, departments, regions, sectors and locals?
scenarios.approvedResponse: Organization-linked structures exist; CUPE hierarchy needs discovery and validation.
scenarios.gap: Implement hierarchy, admin configuration and isolation tests.

scenarios.question: Can users belong to more than one CUPE structure safely?
scenarios.approvedResponse: Multi-context access has not been validated for CUPE.
scenarios.prohibitedClaim: Users can safely switch all CUPE roles.
scenarios.gap: Define and test active context and leakage controls.

scenarios.question: Can locals retain ownership of their files?
scenarios.approvedResponse: Selected pilot paths deny cross-org access.
scenarios.gap: Expand all-route enforcement and execute complete negative suite.

scenarios.question: Can National receive aggregate intelligence without record access?
scenarios.approvedResponse: Requires CUPE-specific access and aggregate design.
scenarios.prohibitedClaim: National can see trends without files.
scenarios.gap: Implement aggregate policy and adversarial tests.

scenarios.question: Can National and local share a case by consent without changing ownership?
scenarios.approvedResponse: No end-to-end sharing workflow was proven.
scenarios.gap: Implement consent, grants, revocation, audit and UI.

scenarios.question: Can an issue progress from intake to closure?
scenarios.approvedResponse: A seeded pilot flow is demonstrable.
scenarios.gap: Validate lifecycle breadth in runtime.

scenarios.question: Can representatives be reassigned?
scenarios.approvedResponse: Pilot assignment is represented.
scenarios.gap: Test departure, absence and audit lifecycle.

scenarios.question: Can matters be reopened or appealed?
scenarios.approvedResponse: Not audited as implemented.
scenarios.gap: Define state machine and tests.

scenarios.question: Can a matter transfer from local to region or National?
scenarios.approvedResponse: Escalation concepts exist, but transfer and ownership semantics are unproven.
scenarios.prohibitedClaim: Matters transfer safely between CUPE structures.
scenarios.gap: Implement transfer acceptance, return and audit.

scenarios.question: Is local-to-National escalation fully governed?
scenarios.approvedResponse: Only the pilot workflow is safe to show.
scenarios.gap: Implement acceptance, return, SLA and audit.

scenarios.question: Can a specialist consult without full file access?
scenarios.approvedResponse: No such access model is ready to demonstrate.
scenarios.gap: Introduce scoped, time-bound, audited grants.

scenarios.question: Can leadership see workload and aging?
scenarios.approvedResponse: Pilot metrics can be shown as pilot data.
scenarios.gap: Validate live calculations and National scopes.

scenarios.question: Are leadership dashboards free of restricted record details?
scenarios.approvedResponse: Record-safe executive aggregation has not been proven.
scenarios.gap: Implement aggregate policy tests and redacted data contracts.

scenarios.question: Can sensitive matters be hidden from senior users?
scenarios.approvedResponse: Matter-level privilege controls are not ready to claim.
scenarios.gap: Add classification and deny tests.

scenarios.question: Are documents protected by stricter access controls?
scenarios.approvedResponse: Pilot attachment controls are evidence-backed; document-level privilege policy is not.
scenarios.gap: Add classifications, grants, legal hold and retention.

scenarios.question: Are role checks server-side?
scenarios.approvedResponse: Selected critical routes have server guards.
scenarios.gap: Full surface inventory and CI coverage.

scenarios.question: Does a hidden menu block direct API calls?
scenarios.approvedResponse: Tested direct unauthorized requests are denied independently of the UI.
scenarios.gap: Keep scope to listed routes.

scenarios.question: Are role changes, revocation and support access governed?
scenarios.approvedResponse: Role update exists; revocation, support and break-glass lifecycle is not proven.
scenarios.gap: Test revocation, dormant accounts, impersonation and break-glass.

scenarios.question: Can case evidence be uploaded and retrieved?
scenarios.approvedResponse: Use approved seeded attachments only.
scenarios.gap: Validate scanner runtime and lifecycle controls.

scenarios.question: Can CUPE apply legal hold, retention, disposition and redaction?
scenarios.approvedResponse: Those controls are not available for this demo.
scenarios.gap: Build lifecycle controls.

scenarios.question: Does the platform preserve institutional memory across turnover?
scenarios.approvedResponse: Structured case history supports a pilot continuity narrative.
scenarios.prohibitedClaim: Continuity is automatic through every organizational change.
scenarios.gap: Add transition playbooks, successor handover and reassignment validation.

scenarios.question: Can CUPE trace a decision from motion to authority, completion and exception?
scenarios.approvedResponse: Audit primitives exist; National decision lineage has not been proven end-to-end.
scenarios.gap: Trace an executable decision lifecycle with RBAC and evidence.

scenarios.question: Can CUPE export reporting safely?
scenarios.approvedResponse: A tested pilot export may be shown with representative data.
scenarios.prohibitedClaim: Exports preserve every downstream access restriction.
scenarios.gap: Add field-level export policy, watermarking, audit and National filter tests.

scenarios.question: Are definitions, filters and cross-organization comparisons trustworthy?
scenarios.approvedResponse: Metric semantics require CUPE discovery and validation.
scenarios.gap: Define data contracts, quality controls, access filters and tests.

scenarios.question: Can CUPE operate equally in English and French?
scenarios.approvedResponse: Locale infrastructure exists; operational parity is unproven.
scenarios.gap: Parity inventory and full workflow tests.

scenarios.question: Is the product WCAG compliant?
scenarios.approvedResponse: Conformance has not been established.
scenarios.gap: Complete automated and manual audit.

scenarios.question: Can users search without data leakage?
scenarios.approvedResponse: The tested wrong-org search is denied or redacted.
scenarios.gap: Test all search/index paths.

scenarios.question: Are deadline, assignment and escalation notifications reliable and bilingual?
scenarios.approvedResponse: In-app notification primitives exist; delivery and language guarantees need validation.
scenarios.gap: Test recipient preference, delivery failure, minimization and audit.

scenarios.question: Can CUPE integrate M365 and existing systems?
scenarios.approvedResponse: Existing primitives need a scoped CUPE proof.
scenarios.gap: Discovery, connectors and security tests.

scenarios.question: Can historical records be migrated?
scenarios.approvedResponse: Migration is a discovery and implementation workstream.
scenarios.prohibitedClaim: Legacy data can be imported now.
scenarios.gap: Build import/reconciliation/rollback.

scenarios.question: Is CUPE National scale proven?
scenarios.approvedResponse: National scale has not been proven.
scenarios.gap: Model and test capacity/failure recovery.

scenarios.question: Where is data stored and is privacy compliance assured?
scenarios.approvedResponse: Current deployment evidence is not a compliance assurance.
scenarios.gap: Data map, PIA/DPIA, vendor and residency review.

scenarios.question: What happens during an outage or privacy incident?
scenarios.approvedResponse: There are operational artifacts, not CUPE-specific exercised continuity evidence.
scenarios.prohibitedClaim: Outage and incident response is proven.
scenarios.gap: Run tabletop, restore and incident drills with evidence.

scenarios.question: Can AI summarize sensitive files?
scenarios.approvedResponse: It is optional, guarded, externally processed and marked for human review; confidential use requires approval.
scenarios.prohibitedClaim: AI is safe for all confidential files.
scenarios.gap: Data-class, provider, consent and audit validation.

scenarios.question: Can AI recommend grievance outcomes?
scenarios.approvedResponse: AI must not determine or recommend outcomes.
scenarios.gap: Keep prohibition explicit and tested.

scenarios.question: Can CUPE disable AI?
scenarios.approvedResponse: Inspected AI endpoints have feature guards; validate tenant-wide CUPE administration before relying on it.
scenarios.prohibitedClaim: Every AI function is centrally disabled today.
scenarios.gap: Verify control plane, defaults, audit and all AI paths.

scenarios.question: Is a generic Union Eyes demo ready?
scenarios.approvedResponse: A constrained seeded pilot demo is appropriate.
scenarios.gap: Freeze demo environment and validate commands.

scenarios.question: Is CUPE National production ready?
scenarios.approvedResponse: No. Production readiness has not been established.
scenarios.prohibitedClaim: CUPE National can go live now.
scenarios.gap: Complete critical backlog and independent validation.
